results.title: Seven Circles of Hell
results.overview: A Ukrainian female soldier and five male soldiers recount the horrors they witnessed and endured on the front line, and their difficult struggle to return to a normal life. The result is a poignant portrait of a generation forced to live with the psychological consequences of a war imposed upon them, and of a society that will continue to bear this burden for a long time to come.

results.title: Blood Red
results.overview: A discontented vampire couple decide to exchange their ancient, eternal boredom for the chance to live a brief but vivid human existence.

results.title: Call Lone Magpie
results.overview: By 2035, the US legalized the commercial hiring of hitmen to combat the soaring crime rates. And amongst them, "Lone Magpie" is considered one of the best in his profession. But throughout the making of his over-the-top commercial, the bravado facade begins to slip, as a morally-conflicted Magpie seeks answers from the director of the advert.

results.title: Out of Hours
results.overview: A British Latino bartender is starting his shift when he receives an unsettling visitor.

results.title: Kibbutz Revadim, the Pioneers' Utopia
results.overview: Israeli kibbutzim once embodied a utopian vision of communal living, collective farming, and shared resources, rooted in the Zionist project. Today, as many have embraced privatization, their founding ideals face new economic, ideological, and political challenges. Through the voices of Revadim’s founders, its transforming generations, and its younger residents, this film explores the legacy of these pioneers and the struggle to preserve their dream amid Israel’s evolving social and political realities.

results.title: Son Of A
results.overview: When a Vietnamese child mysteriously shows up at James and his father’s hawker stall, the two men handle the situation differently, with the child’s fate hanging in the balance.

results.title: The Creator
results.overview: For the Sasak indigenous People community, Cilokaq is not merely a form of entertainment, but a space for expression and identity-building that enjoyed great success during the VCD era; as a second-generation member of the Cilokaq Slemor Ate Jelantik group, Ojan utilises the digital space to revive this traditional music in its purest form amidst a modern industry landscape dictated by social media algorithms and artificial intelligence (AI).

results.title: A Women’s Court
results.overview: The documentary follows women who gather in Nari Adalats in rural Bihar to address conflicts within their communities. Many once came here with their own disputes and now return to listen and help work things out. The film stays with the Adalat as a space where women sit, listen, question, and mediate in sometimes brutal cases. What emerges is not a fixed idea of justice, but something shaped slowly, collectively, and without clear closure.

results.title: Homemade Nature Reserve
results.overview: "On this Saturday I planned to go to Berrylands Nature Reserve to shoot shots for my ongoing project. The horrendous weather prompted me to delay the visit however, and create this, a multimedia project consisting of clips of plants at my home, images from the internet of the reserve, and me reading out the reserve's website header and wikipedia page."

results.title: Pinku Pastels
results.overview: An ordinary slice of life of Mew and Boat during summer break— a period in their lives just before starting the third year of junior high school.

results.title: THEDAL
results.overview: Battle of doubts and journey towards to the answer of a failed young filmmaker..

results.title: Protecting Kahoʻolawe: 50 Years of Aloha ʻĀina
results.original_title: Protecting Kahoʻolawe: 50 Years of Aloha ʻĀina
results.overview: For decades, Kahoʻolawe endured use as a bombing range by the U.S. military, leaving profound scars across an island sacred to Native Hawaiians. This documentary chronicles the history of Kahoʻolawe, the formation of the Protect Kahoʻolawe ʻOhana (PKO), and the extraordinary movement that fought to reclaim and restore the island.

results.title: Thumbprint
results.overview: After the capture and interrogation by the FBI and US government, Japanese photographer Midori Shimoda retells pivotal moments during World War 2 when he escaped California and the internment camps, all in search of his American dream.

results.title: Orphan Myth
results.overview: What if most children living in orphanages are not actually orphans? Studies reveal that nearly 80 percent of institutionalized children worldwide have at least one living parent, challenging long-held assumptions about why children are separated from their families. For many, the underlying cause is not abandonment or a lack of love, but poverty and limited access to resources.

results.title: Un Poeta en Puçol
results.overview: A young poet leaves Seville, a city of balconies full of suitcases and flats for no one, and arrives in Puçol, his grandmother’s town, holding her fan. Between the church, the tower, the fields and the sea, this twenty-something Lorca will search for his place.

results.title: The Hour Of
results.overview: 'The Hour Of' follows three friends who gather for food and the final episode of their favourite Netflix show. What begins as an ordinary evening takes a terrifying supernatural turn, forcing them to confront something far beyond their understanding. As the night unfolds, their friendship is tested, their survival instincts are pushed to the limit, and the familiar comforts become anything but safe.

results.title: Dead Weight
results.overview: Hasan & Omar have to deal with the lifeless body of their friend after an all night study session. Hasan contemplates chopping him up or dissolving him in acid. Whilst Omar, more rooted in reality, insists they wrap him in a rug, take him to the car and bury him 'somewhere nice'. The only problem is, their flat is on the 14th floor, with no lift and it's broad daylight...
